text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. text: Does she have any specific nightmares or fears, such as monsters, death, or separation anxiety, and does she remember the dream content upon waking? Also, has there been any recent stress or changes at home or school that might be affecting her sleep?
